settings.heading: About SHIFT
settings.text:
SHIFT began with the experience of moving from China to Japan and rebuilding the rhythms of everyday life in a smaller home.

When one room has to hold living, working, and unwinding, every object needs a clear reason to be there. The useful things can still bring color, character, and a little joy.

We look for pieces that earn their place: practical for limited space, easy to live with, and good to see every day.
